headline: Authorities Launch Search For Two Escaped Kogi Prison Inmates
seoTitle: Two Inmates Escape Kogi Custodial Centre
metaDescription: Security forces have initiated a manhunt for two convicted inmates who recently escaped from the Medium Security Custodial Centre in Kogi State.
aiSummaryBullets: Two convicted inmates fled the Medium Security Custodial Centre located in Okene, Kogi State.
The Nigerian Correctional Service confirmed the escape occurred on November 8, 2026.
Law enforcement officials have launched an active search operation to locate the missing prisoners.
aiContextParagraph: The Nigerian Correctional Service has officially acknowledged a security breach at the Medium Security Custodial Centre in Okene, Kogi State. According to reports, the incident involved the escape of two convicted individuals who were being held at the facility. The escape took place on November 8, 2026, leading to immediate involvement from local law enforcement agencies. Following the confirmation of the incident, police authorities initiated a widespread manhunt to apprehend the escapees. The facility in Okene is designated as a medium-security site under the administration of the Nigerian Correctional Service. Further details regarding the circumstances of the escape have not been disclosed by the authorities at this time. The investigation remains ongoing as security personnel continue their efforts to recapture the individuals who fled the custody center earlier this week.
whyItIsViral: This incident is currently circulating through two independent national media outlets, resulting in a moderate viral activity score despite low public search interest.
